name: @foldedspacelabs/metistry-cli
description: Metistry command line: `metistry init` stamps a private instance repo from seed/, `metistry doctor` validates every manifest and probes every bridge, service, container and launchd job through the one check() contract, `metistry up` brings a checkout to running (compose + launchd + doctor), `metistry update` pulls, builds, migrates under an advisory lock, restarts what changed and pins metistry.lock. Usable by a stranger: npx @foldedspacelabs/metistry-cli init <dir>.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && rm -rf seed && cp -R ../../seed seed
